brief: Read SPEC.md and design the retries for the checkout's call to the payment provider. Write DESIGN.json in the repository root with exactly these keys: "retry_at" (one of "gateway", "checkout", "payments_client", "none"), "attempts" (an integer, the total number of tries), "per_try_timeout_ms" (an integer), "backoff_ms" (an integer), "idempotency_key" (one of "none", "per_attempt", "per_checkout"), "gateway_retries" ("on" or "off") and "reasons" (a list of short strings).
